108: Until where - does the power of extension [of an oath reach]; [that is, to what additional] cases that do not require an oath can [an oath] be extended?

Where he said to him: you are my Canaanite slave - even in such a case we extend, if he is [already] required to take an oath in a different matter. In the conclusion, [the gemara] explains what cases beyond [extension of an oath to] land cases [are envisioned] by posing [the question] "until where".
